prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent CHARACTER ANIMATION PRODUCTION SOURCE, not a concept sheet.
Generate a 2000x1000 WIDE landscape transparent PNG with exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows of separate, evenly spaced complete character cels, implicit 500x250 cells. No grid lines, labels, text, icons, background, ground, shadow, VFX, air arcs, afterimages, blur, checkerboard paint or detached objects. Each cel comfortably inside its cell with at least35px margin; nothing crosses cell boundaries.
ROWS are independently drawn cardinal facings in this exact order: row1 DOWN/toward viewer, row2 LEFT, row3 RIGHT, row4 UP/away from viewer (rear hair and back of robe; no visible front face). Stable elevated orthographic 3/4 TOP-DOWN RPG perspective, never isometric or side-scrolling. Head top and shoulders visible. For left/right show appropriate three-quarter side/back/front anatomy from the same fixed camera, not flat side-view. COLUMN1 anticipation; COLUMN2 first action; COLUMN3 second action; COLUMN4 followthrough/recovery.
The exact APPROVED Thiên Sơn man is input1; input2 is his approved matching runtime atlas; input3 is THIS skill's approved choreography concept. Lock his face, dark aristocratic topknot/jade-silver pin, long dark hair, ivory silk robes, light-blue lining/ribbons, jade sash/trim, silver clasps, dark small shoes, ~2.5-head chibi proportions. No redesign or new armor. Upper-left illumination and crisp deliberate pixel clusters/stepped selective dark outline. Same costume, cloth panels, weapon geometry, body scale and feet in every cel. Full body from topknot to both shoes approx160 source pixels high, for ~44px runtime height. Feet centered near cell local(250,210), no per-frame body growing. Leave generous weapon clearance.
ANATOMICAL RIGHT hand holds the active weapon in all directions: front view this is screen-left; rear view screen-right. Fan style: ivory open folding COMBAT FAN with readable dark jade ribs and round jade pivot, curved dao SHEATHED on anatomical LEFT hip. Dao style: PLAIN curved silver Chinese DAO with restrained jade grip, closed fan and empty scabbard on anatomical LEFT sash. Do not mirror hand placement, swap weapons or redraw as straight sword.
Each of the16 cells must be a DISTINCT INTENTIONAL new pose, with weapon/arm/torso/cloth action, not a static sprite translated or duplicated. Anticipation compresses stance, action visibly changes weapon angle/body, followthrough recoils and settles. Cloth flutter remains attached and anatomically coherent. Four facings must follow the same choreography.
Wind effects will be separate: do NOT bake any wind arc, slash trail, impact, dust or temporal silhouette into these character cels. This source will be extracted/aligned and edited in Aseprite, not used as a concept.
FAN CLOSE MOVING SPIN. Columns1 compact crouched rotation windup, 2 quarter-turn open-fan sweep with robe hem lifted, 3 half-turn rear/side body with readable right-hand fan, 4 finishes full turn into initial facing and grounded recovery. Each row's start/end faces its named direction; intermediate turning poses MUST change facing during the spin. Stay low, no jumping, no afterimages or wind rings in character sheet.
